integrity: The infinite statement is proved analytically. Numerical computation is used only to locate the unique implicitly defined threshold to a decimal bracket and to stress-test formulas.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the exact right-tail variance-Gaussian inequality for the one-parameter family \(\mathrm{Beta}(1,b)\). It does not classify general beta parameters, the opposite tail, MGF strict sub-Gaussianity, or the optimal positive Bernstein scale above the threshold.
title: Sharp variance-tail threshold in the \(\mathrm{Beta}(1,b)\) family
